typography_roles.title: bold, large, chunky main title with bright fill and dark stroke
typography_roles.subtitle: thin supporting text with bright fill and dark stroke, preferably curved lightly along the portrait outline

templates.prompt_hint: Retain useful real-photo background context, create a large portrait cutout with a cream sticker outline, and place 3-5 large title chunks around the person contour without covering the portrait. Use cream or mint-white title text with deep green or charcoal stroke. No colored title blocks.

Create a high-energy collage background with several image-like tiles, a sticker-cut portrait in front, a thick outlined headline, and a diagonal bottom banner. Rebuild clean original collage tiles; do not use watermarked reference images.
Use a warm kraft-paper background, white grid-paper area, tape strips, small labels, and a large cutout portrait. Keep labels small and the main title in a strong banner or upper-third composition.
Use a natural green or outdoor-blur background, oversized title text in the upper half, and simple white hand-drawn doodles. Keep the title huge and readable in the feed.

Use a sunlit outdoor/photo background, portrait on one side, elegant oversized title chunks near but not on top of the portrait, and minimal white arcs or line accents. Keep the palette leaf green, warm sunlight, pale yellow, and white.
